title: DocumentReleasedPayload
description: Payload of the DocumentReleased event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

docsequence.description: The per-document monotonic sequence (INV-REQ-1221), duplicated in the payload alongside the envelope's own docsequence extension attribute.

releasedHoldReasons.description: The hold reasons released (error-catalogue codes, model/architecture/error-codes.yaml).
